caption: The drawing depicts a small, wooden sewing stand with two drawers. The stand is colored in shades of brown, indicating a wooden texture and finish. The stand has a rectangular top, slightly overhanging the frame, with two square drawers beneath it, each featuring a small round gold-colored knob as a handle. The sewing stand is supported by a single, central turned pedestal that extends downward and branches into three curved, splayed legs, providing stability. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a faint shadow beneath the stand, anchoring it to the surface. The words "Two Drawer Sewing Stand" are written in a gray, hand-lettered style beneath the drawing. The drawing is centered on the page, with some small marks and the number "18" visible in the bottom left corner, and a signature “Louise J. Smith” in the bottom right corner.
title: Shaker Tripod Sewing Stand
